<div class="page-intro">GLISA connects climate science with communities and decision-makers across the Great Lakes, with a focus on producing usable climate information and supporting adaptation planning.</div>

## Research focus

Current work emphasizes **actionable climate knowledge**, **flood resilience**, **climate migration**, and decision-support approaches that connect regional climate science with local priorities.

## How the lab contributes

The Van Berkel Lab contributes geospatial analysis, participatory mapping, scenario planning, visualization, and research on how climate knowledge is translated into planning and policy contexts.

## Methods

Geospatial data science · participatory GIS · scenario planning · visualization · climate services research · co-production
